name: sql-guard
title: SQL Guard
description: Stops a forgotten WHERE from wiping a table: a small tokenizer (comments and strings don't count) flags UPDATE/DELETE without WHERE, a WHERE hidden in a comment, always-true conditions like WHERE 1=1, DROP and TRUNCATE as you type, asks before any write on production, shows estimated affected rows from a pluggable function, and requires typing the table name before a destructive run.
